prompt_profile_selection.guard: Style requests may change formality, vocabulary and sentence rhythm. Preserve every source fact, qualification, attribution, uncertainty, stance and argumentative relationship. Preserve the intended seriousness and attitude even when changing formality. Do not invent facts, personal experiences, opinions, quotations or deliberate errors. Do not use misspellings, invisible characters or encoding tricks. Keep necessary technical terms and measurements. Apply the style only within the requested draft or light-to-moderate copyedit: an edit must still retain most source wording and the order of ideas. Factual fidelity and these operation constraints take priority over style.

notes: Profiles describe requested instructions, not verified author-style matches or successful detector evasion.
Historical human proxies and model-edited proxies have weak origin labels; admission does not certify semantic fidelity.
Primary and reserved cohorts share Test sources. Report retained family counts separately and do not treat paired humans as independent.
Counts distinguish accepted responses from responses retained after whole-family exclusion. All failures remain archived locally.

Two training outputs were read for prompt compliance. One retained stock phrasing; the other omitted details and added an unsupported qualification. No protocol, label, admission or prompt changes followed; this was not a random fidelity audit.
Raw prompts, corpus text and row probabilities are omitted from this public metadata projection.
